signing.mechanism: scripts/release-attestation.js attests name/size/sha256/commit/sandbox for the bytes a run produced; the owner signs offline; verification consumes the same run, never a rebuild
signing.negative_tests: test-release-attestation.js: 9 checks, 7 of them negative (changed bytes, extra file, missing file, short commit, unknown sandbox status, sandbox not PASS, missing signature) plus a real wrong-commit check run at sealing time

signing.excluded: the platform binaries: the two local ones were built from an earlier commit, and CI produces none that can be downloaded, so signing them would misstate their origin

release_pipeline.reason: release.yml has 5 recorded runs, all failure with 0 jobs; the current version has never run successfully. It is triggered only by a v* tag or workflow_dispatch, this environment has no actions:write token, and tags are not allowed
release_pipeline.unblock: three things, all required: (1) an actions:write token, or an approved throwaway rehearsal tag; (2) a runner with user namespaces via the workflow_dispatch "runner" input -- on ubuntu-latest the sandbox job reports HOST_CAPABILITY_BLOCKED and the verdict stays RELEASE_BLOCKED by design; (3) the offline-signed RELEASE_PROVENANCE.json committed so pass 2 can verify the same run's bytes
